profileLabel: Center-left economics (low confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Camarines Norte 1st District representative with about 27 principal-authored bills. Authored two national minimum wage bills and an agricultural pension fund. Authored an anti-dynasty ban for national offices and co-authored the broader anti-dynasty and automatic fuel tax relief bills.
caveat: Two economic issues only; anti-dynasty is a single coalition issue so democratic institutions is not scored. Extractor may under-report.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored national minimum wage bills (-2) and an agricultural pension fund (-2). Co-authored automatic fuel tax relief is direction-neutral. Two issues, bill-based.
